originalPrompt: An exploration ship maneuvers through a vast cloud of charged gas and floating debris. Inside the cockpit, the pilot moves the controls while the captain braces against the console and an alien crew member monitors the storm. The camera moves from the crew toward the forward window, cinematic tension, realistic motion.
